title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description: Can you guess which egg has the dragon inside? Watch to find out! 🐉🔥 #Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Eggs #Kidify #FunForKids #Quiz

scenes.narration: One of these eggs hides a DRAGON! Can you guess which one?
Your three choices: the blue egg, the green egg, or the golden egg!
Pick your egg! The countdown is on — three, two, one!
The blue egg cracks open and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack!
The green egg pops open and… a tiny frog jumps out! Ribbit!
The GOLDEN egg glows, shakes, and BOOM — a baby dragon appears! You got it!
scenes.visual_prompt: golden cracked egg baby dragon toy

scenes.narration: Did you pick the golden egg? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
